commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /tmp/normalize_text_exports.py <<'PY'
import csv
import os
import pathlib
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
incoming = root / 'incoming'
normalized = root / 'normalized'
normalized.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
failures = []

with (root / 'encodings.tsv').open('r', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as mapping:
    rows = csv.DictReader(mapping, delimiter='\t')
    if rows.fieldnames != ['file', 'encoding']:
        raise SystemExit(f'bad encodings.tsv header: {rows.fieldnames!r}')
    for row in rows:
        name = row['file']
        encoding = row['encoding']
        if pathlib.Path(name).name != name:
            raise SystemExit(f'unsafe filename in encodings.tsv: {name!r}')
        source = incoming / name
        target = normalized / name
        raw = source.read_bytes()
        try:
            text = raw.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
        except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
            failures.append((name, encoding, exc.start, exc.reason))
            print(f'UNDECODABLE\t{name}\tencoding={encoding}\tbyte_offset={exc.start}\treason={exc.reason}')
            continue
        output = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
        fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f'.{name}.', suffix='.tmp', dir=normalized)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as temp:
                temp.write(output)
                temp.flush()
                os.fsync(temp.fileno())
            os.chmod(temp_name, source.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
            os.replace(temp_name, target)
        except BaseException:
            try:
                os.unlink(temp_name)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            raise
        print(f'PUBLISHED\t{name}\t{len(raw)} source bytes\t{len(output)} UTF-8/LF bytes')

print(f'SUMMARY\tpublished={sum(1 for p in normalized.iterdir() if p.is_file() and not p.name.startswith("."))}\tundecodable={len(failures)}')
PY
python3 /tmp/normalize_text_exports.py
find /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization/normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.*.tmp' -print

set -eu
cat > /tmp/normalize_text_exports.py <<'PY'
import os
import pathlib
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
incoming = root / 'incoming'
normalized = root / 'normalized'
normalized.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
lines = (root / 'encodings.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
if not lines or lines[0].split() != ['file', 'encoding']:
    raise SystemExit('bad encodings.tsv header')
entries = []
for line_number, line in enumerate(lines[1:], 2):
    fields = line.split()
    if len(fields) != 2:
        raise SystemExit(f'bad encodings.tsv row {line_number}: expected 2 fields')
    entries.append(fields)

published = 0
failures = []
for name, encoding in entries:
    if pathlib.Path(name).name != name:
        raise SystemExit(f'unsafe filename in encodings.tsv: {name!r}')
    source = incoming / name
    target = normalized / name
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    try:
        text = raw.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        failures.append(name)
        print(f'UNDECODABLE\t{name}\tencoding={encoding}\tbyte_offset={exc.start}\treason={exc.reason}')
        continue
    output = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f'.{name}.', suffix='.tmp', dir=normalized)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as temp:
            temp.write(output)
            temp.flush()
            os.fsync(temp.fileno())
        os.chmod(temp_name, source.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
        os.replace(temp_name, target)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(temp_name)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        raise
    published += 1
    print(f'PUBLISHED\t{name}\t{len(raw)} source bytes\t{len(output)} UTF-8/LF bytes')

print(f'SUMMARY\tpublished={published}\tundecodable={len(failures)}')
PY

commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
printf '%s\n' '--- source hashes after conversion ---'
sha256sum incoming/*
printf '%s\n' '--- normalized inventory and hashes ---'
find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\t%#m\t%s bytes\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
sha256sum normalized/*
printf '%s\n' '--- strict semantic verification ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
entries = [line.split() for line in (root/'encodings.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()[1:]]
expected_outputs = set()
for name, encoding in entries:
    raw = (root/'incoming'/name).read_bytes()
    try:
        decoded = raw.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        assert not (root/'normalized'/name).exists(), f'partial output exists for {name}'
        print(f'PASS undecodable-not-published {name}: byte_offset={exc.start}')
        continue
    expected_outputs.add(name)
    expected = decoded.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8')
    actual = (root/'normalized'/name).read_bytes()
    assert actual == expected, f'content mismatch: {name}'
    strict_text = actual.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    assert b'\r' not in actual, f'CR remains: {name}'
    assert actual.endswith(b'\n') == (raw.endswith(b'\n') or raw.endswith(b'\r')), f'final newline changed: {name}'
    print(f'PASS {name}: utf8_strict=yes cr_bytes=0 final_newline={actual.endswith(bytes([10]))} records={len(strict_text.split(chr(10)))} text={strict_text!r}')
actual_outputs = {p.name for p in (root/'normalized').iterdir() if p.is_file() and not p.name.startswith('.')}
assert actual_outputs == expected_outputs, (actual_outputs, expected_outputs)
print('PASS exact output filename set:', ','.join(sorted(actual_outputs)))
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- normalized byte dumps ---'
for f in normalized/*; do printf 'FILE %s\n' "${f##*/}"; od -An -tx1 -v "$f"; done
